# go-toml v2 provenance

EngOrch resolves `github.com/pelletier/go-toml/v2` at `v2.4.3` through
`go.mod` and `go.sum`. `LICENSE` is an exact copy of the primary license in the
locally resolved module cache. Its SHA-256 is
`26844e4b53c5adec04e557fd7dfef281cc0205a7d355626b1c68b778b99e9e7b`.

This module is a normal Go dependency. Retaining its license supports packages
that distribute the Go binary or resolved source. This statement does not
claim that every package mode contains every dependency file.
